note: Madison County Conservation park (45 acres of grassland and red cedar) 8 mi south of Winterset at US 169 and G61. The campground sits on a wooded ridge in the park's northwest corner above a 9-acre fishing pond with jetties and a small-boat landing (electric motors only); hiking trail. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $12 electric pad ($7 tent area), 50-30-20 amp with water at each site, vault toilets, no showers or dump, closed late fall to early spring (season added). Note cleaned of field facts. Stays not waterfront.
